domain: Hospital - Medical Diagnosis and Treatment Recommendation
conflict_resolution: Most specific rule (largest symptom set) wins; on a tie the earlier rule is chosen.

rules.description: IF Fever AND Cough THEN Common Cold
IF Fever AND Chills THEN Malaria
IF Fever AND Abdominal Pain THEN Typhoid
IF Excessive Thirst AND Nausea THEN Diabetes Type 2
IF Fever only THEN possible Common Cold (weak match)
